results.title: Quentin Tarantino Reveals Sacked Inglourious Basterds Actresses
results.description: Quentin Tarantino details firing Isabelle Huppert and Mélanie Laurent from Inglourious Basterds in a new book, explaining contract stalls and poor table reads.

results.title: Holiday Ice Rink Pershing Square Opens for 2026-27 Season with Grand Celebration
results.description: The Holiday Ice Rink at Pershing Square in downtown Los Angeles has opened for its 2026-27 season, operating daily from 3 p.m. to 10 p.m. through January 3. The event features a grand opening celebration with performances and a tree-lighting ceremony, alongside themed skating sessions throughout the winter.
